name: typed-device-tracker
title: Typed negotiated device tracker (long text + proto-binary)
description: Add an always-compiled adboost::tracker client: typed snapshots, DeviceSerial validation, host-features negotiation between host:track-devices-proto-binary and host:track-devices-l, AOSP long-text and protobuf decoders, explicit reconnect/health policy, and fake-server tests. Additive; keep the existing track_devices() API.
creator: jdjingdian
